newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWB sells 2,000/t in eleventh wheat tender.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWB sells 2,000/t in eleventh wheat tender.

text.p: The Australian Wheat Board (AWB) sold 2,000 tonnes of feed wheat at A$139.00 a tonne in its eleventh tender bid, the Australian Wheat Board (AWB) said.
The winning bid was for delivery in Gladstone, Queensland.
Bids for a total of 67,000 tonnes, all new crop wheat, were submitted in five zones, AWB said.
